summary: Rewrite analysis.py as the chosen HistGB, run once to score heldout, write cv/holdout/gap
reasoning: Boost-holdout milestone, the single held-out scoring. Every choice was made on pilot.csv alone: features are the 12 raw columns; model HistGradientBoostingClassifier(lr=0.06, max_leaf_nodes=15, l2=0, max_iter=500, early_stopping=True, validation_fraction=0.25, n_iter_no_change=20, seed 0), selected in two pilot-only grids (9 + 8 configs, all clustering 0.61-0.83, chosen 0.8343). I rewrite analysis.py to compute the same seed-0 5-fold CV on pilot (expect 0.8343 again), refit on all 1000 pilot rows, and score data/heldout.csv once, writing cv_auc, holdout_auc and gap (cv less holdout) as one flat JSON object. Expect holdout_auc >= 0.8 (given pairs-route step-14 evidence that interactions generalize: their pairwise logistic hit 0.8923 cv) and |gap| <= 0.05; the CV std was ~0.023, so a modest optimism of the CV estimate is possible but should stay well inside the window. Run once, single-threaded.
